claims.exact_scope: The actual node y^2+xy-x^3 has distinct simple formal branches in characteristic two; compression permits gaps and only bounds orders by the old real interval length.
failed_attacks: Characteristic-two degeneration of the different complex node does not attack this node.
Frobenius orders 0,p are allowed, not a violation of the compression claim.

claims.exact_scope: For every A,B>0, real kappa>=0 and t>0, the nodal least exponent of a nonzero polynomial supported in kappa Delta(A,B) is in kappa conv{0,(Wt/(1+t),0),(1/d,1/d),(0,W/(1+t))}, with d=max(3/A,2/B), W=dAB, in every characteristic.
claims.decisive_argument: Formal root recursion with multipliers +/-1; injective nodal parametrization proved by even/odd remainder degrees; additive weighted degree; two distinct branch orders bounded by the degree of a nonzero polynomial.

source_locators: Historical reshaping_audit/report.md: Statement and source fidelity; The nodal bound, including characteristic two
finite_evidence: Supplementary truncated node identities and a local rank-two characteristic-two matrix; neither proves the universal nodal bound.
comparison_to_strongest_prior: No improvement beyond the already asserted dw<1/3 and mixed-order maximum-rank result.
